pages.text: These eerie entities wandering the FarLands unsettle you. It is said that they come from a dimension beyond the Overworld, constantly observing everything that happens in this world—including your every action, watched by eyes from beyond...
Using the arm left behind by a Farseer, you can call upon and entice one to serve you for a purpose. As long as you don't mind the feeling of being constantly watched...
